title: Task-conditioned Delta-rule decay coordinate
hypothesis: A compact task View on a shared decay-plus-Hebbian-write rule preserves long-context recall across task-specific retention regimes while using less serialized rule state than independent per-task full update operators.
physical_object: Shared matrix-state update rule W <- lambda W + v k^T
mirror_coordinate: Persistent task coordinate selecting decay lambda

development.selection_metric: paired final-state output nRMSE over short and long sequence prefixes

failure_gate: Quality/reset gate missed, byte savings <25%, or native scalar gate matches Mirror within 1% and has equal/better bytes and compute.
boundaries: Synthetic matrix-state retention only; no trained DeltaNet/Mamba claim.
